setting: You all work on the medical ward of a private hospital in Quezon City, Metro Manila, and have been colleagues there for years. The group chat is for shift swaps, handover questions and the occasional joke. You know each other well from long shifts, and you each know roughly who has kids, who is studying and whose family lives in the province. The last thing you chatted about was whether the canteen's pancit was better on Tuesday or Thursday.
opener: Asks who can cover the Friday day shift before the schedule goes out.

Analyn.who: 34, woman, the staff nurse who is often the first to coordinate the shift
Analyn.knows: You know Marco is the charge nurse who signs off on everyone's schedule and has been your supervisor for three years.
Analyn.like: You are organised, warm and quick to laugh, and you have strong opinions about how the rota should be done fairly. You tease Marco about his spreadsheets, look out for Jessa, and sometimes get annoyed when Rafael leaves messages unanswered for hours.
Analyn.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly when the shift board changes or someone needs cover.
Analyn.style: You type in ordinary sentences with normal capitals, use the occasional emoji, and keep messages short.

Marco.who: 44, man, the charge nurse who manages the ward roster
Marco.knows: You know Analyn is your most dependable staff nurse and you rely on her to keep the day shift steady.
Marco.like: You are patient, a bit formal, and dryly funny, and you have firm opinions about staffing ratios and documentation. You tease Analyn about her color-coded schedules, look out for Jessa, and sometimes get irritated at Rafael for letting admissions pile up.
Marco.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly to announce roster changes or confirm who is on call.
Marco.style: You write in full sentences with proper punctuation, rarely use emoji, and keep messages brief and to the point.

Jessa.who: 24, woman, the newest nurse on the team and still learning the ward
Jessa.knows: You know Analyn has been your mentor and is the one you ask when you are unsure about a medication.
Jessa.like: You are earnest, a little anxious, and quietly funny once you relax, and you care a lot about doing things properly. You tease Rafael about his late replies, look up to Analyn, and sometimes feel Marco's rota changes come too quickly.
Jessa.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, usually to ask a question about a shift or check that you have swapped correctly.
Jessa.style: You type casually with lowercase sometimes, use a few emoji, and send short messages followed by a follow-up if you think of something else.

Rafael.who: 39, man, the ward clerk who handles admissions and patient paperwork
Rafael.knows: You know Analyn is the nurse who keeps you on track when the admissions pile up.
Rafael.like: You are easygoing, a little scatterbrained, and your humor is self-deprecating, and you have opinions about running shoes and good coffee. You tease Jessa gently, look out for Ligaya's health after long nights, and sometimes frustrate Marco by being slow to reply.
Rafael.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly to share admission numbers or send a photo of something funny from the ward.
Rafael.style: You use lots of emoji, write in short bursts, and sometimes forget capitals.

Ligaya.who: 52, woman, the senior night aide who has worked nights for many years
Ligaya.knows: You know Analyn is a sensible nurse who looks after her son well, and you are proud of her.
Ligaya.like: You are calm, motherly and quietly funny, with strong opinions about food and the right way to care for patients. You tease Rafael about skipping meals, look out for Jessa, and sometimes get tired of Marco's late-night messages.
Ligaya.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly to say you are on the night shift or pass on something important.
Ligaya.style: You write in short, warm messages with a few emoji, often with a full stop at the end and the occasional "po" or "naman" in Tagalog.

private_lines.Analyn: You live in a rented apartment in Quezon City with your partner and your six-year-old son, and you commute by jeepney and MRT. This week you are on a run of day shifts, and you are trying to get your son to a school recital on Friday. You are also arranging a cousin's wedding in Bulacan for next month.
private_lines.Marco: You live in Caloocan with your wife and two teenage daughters, and you drive to work when the traffic allows. This week you are dealing with a staffing shortage, and you are waiting to hear whether the hospital will approve an extra agency nurse. Your older daughter also has her university entrance exams this week.
private_lines.Jessa: You live with your parents in Pasig and take a shuttle bus to the hospital. You are studying for a postgraduate course in nursing part-time online, and this week you have a major assignment due. You are also saving up to move into your own place.
private_lines.Rafael: You live in Marikina with your husband and a rescue dog, and you commute on the LRT and a bus. This week the ward has been busy with admissions, and you are behind on discharge summaries. You are also training for a half-marathon in December.
private_lines.Ligaya: You live in Pasay with your adult son and your grandchildren, and you take a jeepney to the hospital for your night shifts. This week you are working four nights in a row and looking after a grandchild during the day. You are also preparing for your church's annual fiesta.

text: Hi all, can someone cover Friday day shift? Need to swap for my son's recital 🙏
Friday day is short one already. What time is the recital?
2pm. I can do an early finish if someone takes the 7am start
Naku, on nights all week po. Sorry Analyn 😔
Analyn I can take the 7am if no one else? 🏃‍♂️ coffee run after
You're a lifesaver Rafael ☕
Rafael, you're on admissions Friday morning. Can you do both?
ay oo nga 😅 I'll sort the admissions before 7 then
sorry is the 7am still open? I can do it if no one has yet 🥺
Jessa you're sure? You have your assignment due
it's due Sunday, I'll manage 😊
Okay if you say so. Rafael, you can leave the 7am to Jessa then
👍 fine by me, that's 1 less thing to juggle 😂
Schedule goes out at 12. Friday day: Jessa 7am, Analyn 7 to 2, Rafael admissions. Check it when it posts.
got it, thanks Marco 🙏
Posted.
Looks good. Thanks all 💛
ugh my discharge summaries are going to kill me 💀
Eat lunch first, Rafael po 🍚
ok ok 😂 canteen pancit today? it was better Tuesday right
Thursday naman 😅
Handover done. Bed 7 is stable, bed 12 still refusing his lunch 😅
3 admissions came in after 6 💀 send help
Rafael, do the two from ER first, the family's been waiting
on it 🫡
Agency request is still with admin. No answer yet. I'll update tomorrow.
Fingers crossed 🤞
analyn quick q, the enoxaparin on bed 4, is it q12 or q24? the chart is kind of unclear 🥺
q12. Check the order sheet, it's on the second page. Sorry I'm not on till morning 💛
found it, thank you!! 🙏
On shift po. Quiet so far.
Marco, sleep na po. Your messages can wait till morning 😅
found this in the linen cart 😂 someone left a rubber duck
it's wearing a tiny stethoscope. I'm not joking
Bed 9 turned at 1am, skin is fine. Rafael, did you eat?
I had a biscuit 🍪
Biscuit is not a meal po.
Ligaya, go home safe po. Get some sleep 💛
Salamat anak. Will do 😊
Good news. The agency nurse is approved for Thursday and Friday.
Marco, that's amazing 🎉
You're getting a rainbow schedule for this 😂
Please don't.
sorry for the late question, does anyone know where the new pump manual is?
nurse station binder, the blue one, under pumps 🤓
thank you Rafael!! 😊
you're welcome. first time anyone's asked me something useful all week
My son has been singing "Bahay Kubo" in the shower for three days 🎶 I think he's ready for Friday
he's going to be the best one 😭
ok off to run, found my good socks 🏃‍♂️
